name: proposal-clarify
title: Clarify questions
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Question cards with segmented answers and a live impact: previous hours struck through, new hours, a delta, reasons, and price and timeline ranges.

files.content:
"use client" /** Clean-room clarify step. Answers rewrite hours, price, and the reason list. */ import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge" import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" import { clarificationImpact, formatHours, formatMoney, type ClarifyQuestion, } from "@/lib/proposal" import { SegmentedControl } from "@/components/ui/segmented-control" import { TextMorph } from "@/components/ui/text-morph" export type ProposalClarifyProps = { questions: readonly ClarifyQuestion[] answers: Readonly> onAnswer: (questionId: string, value: string) => void baseHours: number rate: number hoursPerWeek?: number locale?: string currency?: string hoursLabel?: string previousLabel?: string reasonsLabel?: string emptyReasons?: string priceLabel?: string timelineLabel?: string weeksSuffix?: string className?: string } export function ProposalClarify({ questions, answers, onAnswer, baseHours, rate, hoursPerWeek = 30, locale = "en-US", currency = "USD", hoursLabel = "Hours", previousLabel = "Previous", reasonsLabel = "Why it changed", emptyReasons = "No change yet", priceLabel = "Price range", timelineLabel = "Timeline", weeksSuffix = "wk", className, }: ProposalClarifyProps) { const impact = clarificationImpact({ baseHours, questions, answers, rate, hoursPerWeek }) const hours = formatHours(impact.next, locale) const previous = formatHours(impact.previous, locale) return (
{questions.map((question) => (

{question.prompt}

{question.detail ?

{question.detail}

: null} ({ value: option.value, label: option.label }))} value={answers[question.id]} onValueChange={(value) => onAnswer(question.id, value)} />
))}

{hoursLabel}

{previousLabel} {previous} {hours} {impact.delta > 0 ? "+" : ""} {formatHours(impact.delta, locale)}

{reasonsLabel}

{impact.reasons.length === 0 ? (

{emptyReasons}

) : (
    {impact.reasons.map((reason) => (
  • {reason.label} {reason.hours > 0 ? "+" : ""} {formatHours(reason.hours, locale)}
    • ))}
)}
{priceLabel}
{formatMoney(impact.priceLow, locale, currency)} – {formatMoney(impact.priceHigh, locale, currency)}
{timelineLabel}
{formatHours(impact.weeksLow, locale)}–{formatHours(impact.weeksHigh, locale)} {weeksSuffix}
) }
